title: T1000-E: Serial local transport
description: Validate serial local-client transport on T1000-E via native USB CDC. Test USB enumeration and frame exchange.
close_reason: Already fixed: USB CDC serial transport validated through T1000-E bring-up. Evidence: (1) Board DTS has cdc_acm_uart0 with compatible=zephyr,cdc-acm-uart, defconfig enables CONFIG_USB_DEVICE_STACK=y and CONFIG_USB_CDC_ACM=y. (2) USB enumeration documented in AGENTS.md at /dev/serial/by-id/usb-Seeed_Studio_T1000-E_<serial>-if00. (3) Frame exchange validated per t1000e-techo-lora-bringup-notes.md: KISS transport over USB CDC works, beacons and native.c communication tested, known USB-CDC stall issues characterized and worked around with old USB stack. (4) flash-t1000e.sh uses serial DFU via USB CDC successfully. (5) KISS transport implementation (kiss_transport.c) is complete for UART/USB-CDC frame exchange.
